debit.notes: 24x7 customer care toll-free lines for hotlisting: 1800 233 4526 or 1800 102 2636 (debit-card page lists them as '1800 102 2636 / 1800 233 4526'); no chargeable alternate and no overseas line is published. Internet Banking (MahaConnect, www.mahaconnect.bank.in) and the Zen Lyfe mobile app are listed as hotlist channels, but no menu path and no app-store links are published on the bank's pages. WhatsApp Banking 917066036640 and a branch visit are also listed as channels. No SMS hotlist keyword or short code is published. mahaconnect@bankofmaharashtra.bank.in is the email shown on the bank's hotlisting page for ATM card issues (ATM Card Cell, Pune; card or account number to be furnished). After a fraudulent transaction the bank directs customers to dial 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: Bank of Maharashtra has taken a strategic decision to exit from the credit card business; new cards are BOM SBI co-branded cards 'jointly issued by SBI Cards and Bank of Maharashtra', and the bank's credit-card page directs cardholders to the Bank of Maharashtra call centre at 1800-233-4526. No dedicated credit-card hotlist line, email, SMS format, or overseas number is published on the bank's own pages.

upi.notes: UPI runs on the bank's Zen Lyfe app: the Maha UPI page says 'Download the Bank of Maharashtra Zen Lyfe App from Google Play/ App Store to avail this facility on your registered mobile number' and lists 'All India Toll Free Number : 1800-233-4526 / 1800-102-2636'. No in-app UPI-lock menu path is published on the bank's pages (the Zen Lyfe page FAQ covers only registration: download from the official Apple App Store/Google Play Store, verify with Customer ID or Account Number, complete mandatory device binding), no netbanking UPI-manage path is published (the MahaConnect public FAQ has no UPI content), and no SMS/USSD keyword is published (*99# not mentioned). UPI Terms & Conditions: entering the wrong UPI PIN thrice 'will block the UPI facility for 24 hours'; for UPI Lite 'The User shall immediately disable or report UPI Lite in the event of device loss, theft or compromise'; if the mobile number is 'allotted to another person, or blocked' or unauthorized transactions occur, 'user has to make sure that the facility is deregistered for his / her mobile no.' — deregistration via the toll-free lines above. After fraud the bank directs 'Dial 1930 or report cybercrime at https://cybercrime.gov.in'.
